text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cheered on by her friends, El Condor Pasa 
delivers a strong performance in the Kyodo 
News Hai.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, this race was merely a stepping 
stone. Having diverged from the Classic 
route, she agonized over which race to 
enter next.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Around that time, she is advised by her 
respected senior, Seeking the Pearl, to 
enter the "NHK Mile Cup."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To become an Umamusume acknowledged by the 
world, El Condor Pasa decided to enter a 
GⅠ race guaranteed to be a fierce battle.
